slides.texte_overlay:
How to be a man
she feels safe with
Be the same man in private and in public. Kind in front of friends, kind at home. Consistency is the foundation of trust in any relationship.
Stay calm when you disagree. Lower your voice, don't storm out, don't insult. She should never be afraid to tell you something difficult.
Respect her no, every single time. About plans, about touch, about anything. A man who accepts a no without sulking is a man people feel safe around.
Keep your promises, even small ones. If you said you'd call at eight, call at eight. Reliability in little things builds trust for the big ones.
Bring calm into the relationship. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a steadier mind makes me a more patient, present partner.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A steadier mind makes me a more patient, present partner.

slides.texte_overlay: Support her goals out loud. Her career, her studies, her friends. A partner who cheers you on makes you feel free, not controlled.
Own your mistakes quickly. "You're right, I was wrong, I'm sorry." Easy apologies make hard conversations feel safe instead of dangerous.
